# jq binaries

Version: 1.7.1
Source: https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.7.1
License: MIT

Platform binaries:
- darwin-x64: macOS Intel (831K)
- darwin-arm64: macOS Apple Silicon (789K)

Total size: ~6.4M
